The Stormpike Guard (or the Stormpike Expedition, the Stormpike Army, and the Stormpike Brigade) is the Alliance faction in the Alterac Valley battleground. They are an expedition of dwarves of the Stormpike clan in search of artifacts and minerals. The Stormpikes' search for relics of their past, and harvesting of resources in Alterac Valley have led to open war with the orcs of the Frostwolf clan who are dwelling in the southern part of the valley. They were also issued with a "sovereign imperialistic imperative" by King Magni Bronzebeard to take the valleys of Alterac for Ironforge. The dwarves have allied with the Bloodfang pack and claimed the Purgation Isle in Hillsbrad in order to com

The Stormscale naga have taken residence in Darkshore at the Ruins of Mathystra as well as within the Cliffspring Falls caverns. The Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore serves as the principal source of drinking water for the region. Now something is polluting the water, and in turn corrupting Darkshore's entire water table. Sick deer have been seen all over area, and not just by the river. It is rumored that the naga, under the command of Lord Sinslayer, have poisoned the water. At some point, the vrykul warriors Kakushan and Ivagont laid waste to the village of Stormscale naga in Darkshore. As such, only Lord Sinslayer can be found in Darkshore, with the unnamed members all being gone after the

The Stormspire is a neutral Consortium-run town located in Netherstorm. It is located beneath the interconnected eco-domes of Sutheron and Skyperch. Lush jungle vegetation grows within the settlement creating a sharp contrast with the purple, arcane-channeled sky. The town itself is of draenei architecture, however there are no draenei to be seen here now. Nexus-Prince Haramad, leader of the Consortium, is found in his chambers at the uppermost part of the Spire. He oversees the town through a holographic image. Haramad deals with Prince Kael'thas and the forces of Azeroth alike. The Consortium uses this base to engage in activities such as excavation, mining and trading throughout the Nethe
__NOTOC__ Stormsnouts are thunder lizards found roaming the Southern Barrens.
Stormpike Owls are level 42-79 owls found in Alterac Valley.

__NOTOC__ Stormherald is crafted with Outland Blacksmithing (70); previously taught by weaponsmithing trainers as part of the hammersmithing specialty. The recipe can no longer be learned, since all weaponsmithing trainers were converted to regular blacksmithing trainers in . It was not removed from the recipe lists of blacksmiths who'd already learned it.

The Stormpike clan is a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes. They are apparently rich dwarves as well and are said to have an eye for excellence. Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters. The dwarven Stormpike Expedition has set up residence in the valley to search for natural resources and ancient relics. Despite their intentions, the dwarven presence has sparked heated conflict with the Frostwolf Orcs to the south, who have vowed to drive the interlopers from their lands.
Stormreaver Shadow-Kilt is a cloth leg armor. It has a white skull motif.
__NOTOC__ Stormreaver Warblades are a nice rogue or fury warrior offhand weapon. The model matches with Reflex Blades.

The Stormpike Aid Station is the alliance's graveyard in the heart of Dun Baldar itself in Alterac Valley. It is the final graveyard marks the final that the horde can assualt before attacking the alliance commander Vanndar Stormpike in Dun Baldar bunker itself. It's capture is often the signal of comeplete horde domination of Dun Baldar - and the alliance lost of all NPCs that could aid in the horde's defeat. Like all alliance owned graveyards, it is protected by 4 Stormpike Guards at the start of the battle. It take 4 minutes for the graveyard to finish switching control once the flag is captured. Guards are replaced when the graveyard switchs control or after a length of time.
Stormsong Kilt drops from The Black Stalker in the Underbog (heroic mode) wing of Coilfang Reservoir. It is an epic mail legs armor for elemental shamans.
Stormreaver Necrolytes are Stormreaver orc necrolyte creeps that can be encountered in the Sunken Ruins tileset. They are heavy ranged creeps.
The Stormpike Insignia Rank 1 is a quest reward from Proving Grounds (Alterac Valley) (Alliance). It can be exchanged for the next rank through Rise and Be Recognized (Alliance).
The Stormpike Battle Standard is a flag on a pole which is carried by Alliance forces in Alterac Valley. Players can buy the standard at two vendors.

The Stormreaver Wreckage is the name of a location in the body of water in between the Broken Isles. As seen on the map, it is filled with the wreckage of the ill-fated fleets of the Stormreaver clan.
Stormforged Hauberk is created with Blacksmithing (330); taught once by Armorsmithing trainers.
Stormpike Commander's Flesh drops from Alliance players in Alterac Valley, and in low numbers from NPCs. It can be turned in at the Horde base to Wing Commanders.

Stormrage is the name of a World of Warcraft novel by Richard A. Knaak. The novel centers around Malfurion Stormrage; Christie Golden confirmed it was definitely not about Illidan at BlizzCon 2008, and Chris Metzen and Micky Neilson said Malfurion would play a major role at New York Comic Con 2009. The storyline explores the corruption of the Emerald Dream. The story also takes place after the War against the Lich King as evidenced by Sylvanas' nightmare, where she notes that Arthas has already been defeated. In an excerpt released, it is revealed that the minds of the entire town of Goldshire have been trapped in the Emerald Nightmare. An audiobook version read by Richard Ferrone was releas

Stormstrike Mace from Erekem in the Violet Hold on heroic mode.

Stormhoof was a taunka who lived hundreds of years before the present in Camp Tunka'lo, high in the Storm Peaks. He was the brother of Swiftspear, the chieftain of the tribe. He is revered as a hero by the taunka for battling their ancient enemy, the North Wind.
The Stormforged Shoulders are a quest reward from Diametrically Opposed.
Stormpike Shredder Unit is a shredder summoned by Zinfizzlex's Portable Shredder Unit in Alterac Valley.

Stormjewel is an gem that can be found by fishermen when doing Dalaran daily fishing quests. They can either be found in a Bag of Fishing Treasures (Dalaran), or the treasure bag can contain a Tiny Titanium Lockbox which in turn can contain a stormjewel. Prior to patch 3.2, they were the only Northrend epic gems availabe to non-Jewelcrafters. They provide identical bonuses to the "ordinary" epic gems added in that patch.
Stormpike Perfection is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning the Alterac Valley without losing a tower or captain and must also control all of the Horde's towers.
Stormforged Iron Giants are the large iron giants that protect Fjorn and his anvil in Storm Peaks. You cannot see them or Fjorn once you have handed in the quest from the metal they drop.
Storming the Citadel (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the first four bosses in Icecrown Citadel on 10-player mode.
Stormforged Raider are trying to raid Bouldercrag's Refuge. They are assisted by Stormforged Reavers.
__NOTOC__ Stormforged Reavers are assisting the Stormforged Raiders that try to raid Bouldercrag's Refuge in the Storm Peaks.

Stormspire Drakes are nether drakes found at the Stormspire in the Netherstorm. They act as the base's aerial guardians.

.]] Stormfury, Black Blade of the Betrayer drops from the Lich King in the 10-man version of Icecrown Citadel. According to Muradin Bronzebeard, as Arthas Menethil fought Illidan Stormrage, it must have belonged to the Betrayer and was taken as a trophy by the fallen prince.
Stormglen Village is a small village located in the southern edge of the Blackwald in Gilneas. The corruption that seems to haunt the forest is also present in the town.

The Stormhammer Head is contained in Treasures from Grim Batol, a quest reward from Soften them Up.
Stormforged Legguards are created with Blacksmithing (480); taught by trainers.

The Stormstout Brewery was the third announced 5-man dungeon of World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria. The brewery has been overrun by the virmen and hozen, a couple of the less-than-savory races that also inhabit Pandaria. You’re tasked with reclaiming his family heritage... and his beer. It is the brewery of Chen Stormstout's ancestors.
Stormlings are unbound air elementals located in the Vortex Pinnacle.
Stormherald Eljrrin is an optional quest that leads to the questgiver in Halls of Lightning.
Stormstout Brewers are pandaren located at Thirsty Alley and Stormstout Brewery in the Valley of the Four Winds.

The Stormsea Landing is the mogu palace's shipyard currently being used by the Zandalari trolls and their warship. The landing can be found southeast of the Bloodied Crossing on the northeast side of the Isle of Thunder. The entrance to the Swollen Vault is roughly halfway between the crossing and the dock. Additionally, there is a large door connecting to the Conqueror's Terrace to the southwest.

During the instance version, the monkeys are holding a party in here where Ook-Ook is the party leader. During Cleaning House, Jooga can be found here.

Stormsong may refer to: ;Locations *Stormsong Valley, a zone in Kul Tiras. *Stormsong Monastery, a subzone in Boralus. ;Factions *House Stormsong, one of the ruling houses of Kul Tiras. ;Characters *Lord Stormsong, ruler of House Stormsong. *Brannon Stormsong, nephew of Lord Stormsong. *Jevan Grimtotem, a tauren of the Grimtotem tribe commonly known as Stormsong.
Stormshield Knight are summonable Alliance NPCs found in Ashran's Road of Glory.
Stormshield Vanguard are Alliance NPCs found throughout the Road of Glory in Ashran.
__NOTOC__ Stormshield Gladiators are Alliance guards found throughout Stormshield Stronghold in Ashran.
Stormshield Field Marshal are dwarf guards found standing behind the generals in Stormshield Stronghold in Ashran.
Stormshield Guards are guards found in Stormshield. Some appear further in Ashran.
Stormshield Prison Key can be used to unlock the cages of Alliance Prisoners found in Stormshield Stronghold. See Ashran Prisoners.
Stormshield Keep is a sub-zone in Stormshield Stronghold, Ashran. The keep holds the Alliance generals in Ashran, numerous guards and access to the Stormshield prison.
Stormshield Peasants are humans found in Stormshield and Stormshield Stronghold, Ashran, doing construction and supply work.

Stormsinger Taalos is a Draenei elemental shaman located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, he appears in Stormwind Harbor at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Stormshield Excavation is a mine dug into Ashran and controlled by the Alliance. It connects into the Breach which then connects to Amberlight Cavern, Rukmaz's Vault, and Warspear Excavation.
The Stormshield Courier rides around Stormshield and occasionally reports to Austin Feeney at the Town Hall.
The following NPCs can be found in the Alliance main hub in the alternate , on Ashran.
Stormshield Mine Guards are guards found outside Stormshield Excavation in Ashran. One of them has a mastiff pet.
Stormshield Miners are humans found in Stormshield Excavation in Ashran.
Stormshield Engineers are gnomes found in Stormshield Excavation in Ashran.
Stormshield Rock Cutters are found in Stormshield Excavation in Ashran. They are operated by Stormshield Rock Cutter Pilots.

The Stormheim storyline is one of the four level-up zones in Legion on the Broken Isles. Started by choosing Stormheim from the Scouting Map in an Class Hall, Stormheim starts with an Alliance-vs-Horde scenario which later spills over into the greater mysteries of the zone. The progression of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Vrykul Story, Bro.

The Stormpike Battle Master is a Stormpike dwarf who appears on Purgation Isle in Hillsbrad Foothills during Heroes of the Horde!. Kingslayer Orkus kills him or her in order to allow the player to retrieve the Alliance Battle Plans from their corpse.
Stormscale is skinned from various beasts on the Broken Isles. This item is also a quest reward from Skin Deep.
Stormforged Vrykul Horn is a toy found in Skyhold Chest of Riches, which is obtained in the Skyhold Arena of Glory in Skyhold.
Stormscale Cavern is a cavern found in the Weeping Bluffs of Stormheim. It is entered by climbing on the ruined deck of the Skyfire.
Stormpike Soldiers are Stormpike Guard soldiers located at Corrahn's Dagger in the Hillsbrad Foothills. During the Legion Invasions, they defended the area.

Stormpike Battle-Priests are friendly dwarven priests located at Corrahn's Dagger in the Hillsbrad Foothills during the Legion Invasions. They can be seen healing Stormpike Soldiers, and Battle-Mender's Dressings are often nearby.

Stormpike Trainees are Stormpike Guard soldiers located at The Headland in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Some of them are equipped with foam swords. After being poisoned, the ground is littered with their bodies. During the Legion Invasions, they could be found injured or being cornered by demons. Saving them would improve the score of defense against the Legion.
__NOTOC__ Stormrays can be fished from the waters of Stormheim.
__NOTOC__ The Stormforged Rune drops from the Assembly of Iron in Ulduar.
Stormforged Obliterators are iron vrykul that assist Odyn during his encounter in the Halls of Valor on Heroic and Mythic difficulties.
Stormforged Shieldmaidens are vrykul shieldmaidens of the Valarjar found in the Assault on Broken Shore scenario, at Deliverance Point, and aboard the Vindicaar.
Stormforged Protectors are iron vrykul located at Aalgen Point in the Broken Shore.
Stormreaver Apprentices are Stormreaver orc creeps that can be encountered in the Sunken Ruins tileset.
Stormreaver Hermits are Stormreaver orc creeps that can be encountered in the Sunken Ruins tileset.
Stormreaver Warlocks are Stormreaver orc warlock creeps that can be encountered in the Sunken Ruins tileset. They are heavy ranged creeps.
Stormstout Gold is an alcoholic beverage mentioned by Aspiring Trainees watching over the fight between Quiet Lam and Ironfist Zhou. It is presumably brewed by the Stormstout family.

Stormpike Mine Layers were members of the Stormpike Guard and could be found in Alterac Valley until the revamp of the battleground to make it smaller and more focused. They were laying mines that would blow up on Horde members.
Storming Saison can be purchased from the following vendors during the Brewfest: *Thunderbrew Apprentice *Thunderbrew "Apprentice"
Stormforged Horn is provided as an objective for the following quests: *Stem the Tide *Stormwing the Portals
Stormglen Mastiffs are mastiffs that fight with Stormglen Defenders against Worgen Invaders in Stormglen Village in Gilneas.
Stormpike Engineers are dwarves and gnomes located in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Stormforged Trackers are iron dwarves located in the Abandoned Camp in the Storm Peaks.
__NOTOC__ Stormsong Loyalists are humans located at the Stormsong Monastery in Boralus as well as in Tiragarde Sound and Stormsong Valley
The Stormheim Scouting Report was a reward from Reconnaissance: Stormheim.
Stormsong Youths are humans located at Brennadam Square in Stormsong Valley before the Horde assault.
Stormshield Rats are found in the Stormshield Prison of Stormshield Stronghold.

Stormsong Hunters are humans located at Highland Pass in Stormsong Valley. Three have been trapped in ice by Ice Sickle.
Stormsong Mead can be found in a hidden alcove in the middle of the Stormsong Monastery in Boralus. It's contents enjoyed by Tidesage Archivists and Stormsong Loyalists.
Stormray Angling is a fishing artifact trait. It is linked to the Bloodfishing and Better Luck Next Time traits. A fishing cast on a Fever of Stormrays has a chance to spawn a barrel of fish.
Stormslayer Champion Belt drops from Glimar Ironfist in Stormheim.

Stormsong Monastery is a tidesage monastery located in Boralus. The tidesages only allow visitors who travel by boat. Behind the main building, there is an Ominous Altar in the pit of water next to the other altar.
The Stormrigger Harpoon is a harpoon put on display in Unity Square in Boralus. It was likely used by the Outriggers to kill something big.
The Stormsong Valley storyline seeks to answer the question of what happened to the Kul Tiran fleet. Completing the storyline will award the achievement Stormsong and Dance.

Stormsteel Girdle is created with Blacksmithing; taught by for at a skill of (120).
Stormsteel Legguards are created with Blacksmithing; taught by for at a skill of (120).

Stormsong Traders are humans located in the Tiragarde Customs Agency in Boralus and Hatherford in Tiragarde Sound.
Stormlurker's Cowl drops from Vol'zith the Whisperer in the Shrine of the Storm.
Stormreaver Fearmongers were doomguard disguised as Stormreaver orcs located in the Court of Lights in Talador.
Stormsong Supplies are found in caves of Quilltop in Stormsong Valley.
Stormsong Sourdough is sold by innkeepers and food vendors on Kul Tiras.
Storming Furies are air elemental furies located in Stormheim during the Legion Assaults.
Stormforged Shield is created with Blacksmithing (470); taught by trainers.
Stormhoof's Mail drops from the Scions of Storm in the Storm Peaks.
Stormhoof's Spear drops from the Scions of Storm in the Storm Peaks.

Stormsong Crusaders are humans located in Stormsong Valley. They were encountered by Horde champions.
Stormsong Inspectors are humans located in Stormsong Valley.
Stormsong Packhorses are horses located in Stormsong Valley and Tiragarde Sound.
The Stormherald of Rakish was to be an objective of Preying on Predators.
Stormglen Defenders are humans located in Stormglen Village in Gilneas. They are fighting Worgen Invaders with their mastiffs.
Stormglen Villagers are humans located in Stormglen Village in Gilneas.
Stormshield Rock Cutter Pilots are gnomes riding Stormshield Rock Cutters in Stormshield Excavation in Ashran.
The Stormpike Battle Ram is a ram mount from the Classic Alterac Valley battleground during WoW's Anniversary. It was introduced with WoW's 15th Anniversary.
Stormpike Landmines are land mines laid by Stormpike Mine Layers in Alterac Valley. They will only trigger when Horde characters step on them.
Stormhowl is a worg located at Sunblossom Hill in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms during a mogu assault.

Stormfused Weapons drop from the following mobs in Stormsong Valley: *Shipwright Turncoat *Brinebrawn Cannoneer *Stormfused Strikesmith The item is also contained in the following objects: *Abyssal Spear *Harpoons *Thundershot Rifle *Tidal Blade
__NOTOC__ Stormfused Strikesmiths are harvest golems located in Stormsong Valley.
Stormglide Steps drop from Uu'nat in the Crucible of Storms.
Stormsong Kodiaks were bears planned to drop Pristine Kodiak Pelt in Stormsong Valley.
__NOTOC__ Stormstout Inn is an inn found in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle. Brewery Assistant is found behind its Kitchen Table. Researching Brewhouse unlocks the inn and the Bubbling Keg.

Storming the Sanctum is the breadcrumb to the Sanctum of Domination raid. Players will be offered this quest after they finish chapter four of the Chains of Domination campaign. It is not required to continue the campaign.
Stormsnout Stompers are a quest reward from Marching On Our Stomachs.
Stormsoaked Rabbits are rabbits located in the eastern Forbidden Reach.
__NOTOC__ Stormspine is a thunder lizard located in a cave at the Old Weyrn Grounds in the Forbidden Reach.
Stormhide Salamanther can be purchased from Mythressa in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken for .
The Stormshroud Matriarch is a storm drake located at Stormshroud Peak in Thaldraszus.
Stormlash's Last Resort drops from Raszageth in the Vault of the Incarnates.
Storming the Runway is a collection achievement earned for collecting a full armor set from the Primal Storms event.
__NOTOC__ Stormshackler Rynea is a night elf located in a cave in Winterpelt Hollow in the Azure Span. She captured Chieftain Kranac Sagesnow and tried to corrupt his furbolgs.
Stormpike Battle Plans would be looted from Vanndar's Documents.
Stormshield Stormcrows are night elf druids in stormcrow shapes located in Ashran.
Strange Dust is used by enchanters, obtained by disenchanting good quality (Green) or better weapons or armor. Also, Strange Dust can be bought from certain vendors.
__NOTOC__ Stormwind Commendation Officer was a human quest giver located in the Military Ward in Ironforge.

The Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar features a few quest givers and several vendors, among them an innkeeper with the usual services. The inn is a popular place to spend some quality time with one's guildmates, drinking and chatting. It is one of the most popular places to go in Loch Modan.
Strange Spores were used for cooking Sporeling Snack, the recipe has since been removed from the game.

A Stormwind Guard's Card is a pledge gift given out by NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. These are combined into packages which are in turn hierarchically combined with other pledge packages for buffs and rewards. All of the Love is in the Air pledge gifts are non-functional as regards their name and picture. You cannot read a Stormwind Guard's Card. __NOTOC__
Stormwind Ho! is an Alliance quest in Hillsbrad Foothills that involves killing Naga southeast of Southshore to find the Naga.
Moths... why did it have to be moths... This is part of The Terokkar Mana Bomb quest chain.

Strange Findings is an Alliance-only quest in the draenei starting zone Azuremyst Isle. Players find a Faintly Glowing Crystal in the belly of an Infected Nightstalker Runt and must show it to Exarch Menelaous at Azure Watch.
